LESSON: PEACE

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Citizenship and Governance in Kenya
Topic 5.2: Peace

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Peace. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LEARN

FACTORS OR REASONS THAT PROMOTE PEACE IN SCHOOL [ ] Hallo learner, welcome to our social studies lesson for grade 4. Today we shall learn about factors or reasons that promote peace in our school. [ ]

Hallo learner, welcome to our social studies grade 4 lesson. Today we shall learn about factors that promote peace in school. So get your book and pencil and let us learn social studies. I am your radio teacher Eugene Kimani. [ ] I hope you have the book and pen ready and set to learn. We are going to start the lesson by remembering what we learnt about ways in which children are abused in the community. What did we say about child abuse? Answer when you hear the [ ] Very good, we said that child abuse is harming a child in a physical, sexual or emotional way. For example: Slavery, Child labour, Child trafficking, Abuse of children with special needs Sexual abuse, early and forced marriages and female circumcision. Today we are going to learn about living in peace with others in school. Now listen to this story about Furaha primary school. [ ] At Furaha primary school, learners are encouraged to live in peace with each other. The learners help one another with WORK such as cleaning the school. They share things such as story books. The teachers make sure that all learners get learning materials such as textbooks. The learners choose their school leaders. The learners at Furaha primary school follow the rules. They also respect one another. Each class in the school holds peace meetings where the learners and their teachers talk about the problems they may be having. Peace has made the school perform very well in the county. [ ] Very good, Now, from our story what are the things that make Furaha primary school peaceful? Answer when you hear the [ ] Very good, I am sure you have answers like. Learners help one another with chores. Learners share their things such as storybooks. Learners choose their school leaders. Learners follow school rules. Learners respect one another. Learners hold peace meetings with their teachers. Now the things that make Furaha primary school peaceful such as respect and kindness are known as factors that promote peace. Now say other factors or reasons that promote peace in your school? Answer when you hear the [ ] Learner I hope you have answered. Reasons why there is peace in your school is because there is love, respect, kindness, caring, hard work among learners. Now these are some of the factors that promote peace in school.

Recite this poem after me about peace. [ ] Peace! peace! peace! In school peace is very important. We need peace in school, For us to study well. What can I do? I will respect others. I will follow school rules. I will help others. What can you do? To promote peace in school? [ ] Now write down why it is important to keep peace in school and read them aloud to your parent or guardian. We have come to the end of our lesson for today. [ ] You have been listening to a social studies programme for grade 4 learners. Your radio teacher was Eugene Kimani. This programme was recorded by John Mbiti. Until next time, Goodbye.

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Peace means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Peace.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Peace
2. Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
3. Learning materials: SST_PROGRAMME_12 FACTORS OR REASONS THAT PROMOTE PEACE IN SCHOOL; PROGRAMME_10 QUALITIES OF GOOD CITIZENSHIP IN SCHOOL
4. Revise with the quiz now.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
